note: 周考题库。每次周考一条，papers 是每天发的卷子（第1–5天）。卷子里的内容放两种地方：items 放单词/句子（en + zh，网站自动出 英→中、中→英 选择题；kind 可写 word 或 sent，不写时按单词数自动判断）；questions 放卷子上的原题（q 题干、options 选项、answer 正确选项的序号，从 0 开始；explain 可写解析）。考试默认从本周全部卷子里抽 30 题。

papers.title: 第1天

questions.q: The hydraulic pump needs repairing at once. According to the statement, what needs repairing?
questions.qzh: 液压泵需要立即修理。根据这句话，什么需要修理？
questions.explain: need doing = 需要被……

questions.q: In this sentence, "The team prepares for work." "Work" is the ______.
questions.qzh: 在句子 “The team prepares for work.”（团队为工作做准备）中，“Work” 是______。
questions.explain: The team 是主语，prepares 是谓语动词，work 是宾语

questions.q: Rub the area with lint-free cloth that is moist with solvent. According to the instruction, how to rub the area?
questions.qzh: 用蘸有溶剂的不起毛的布擦拭该区域。根据这条指令，怎样擦拭该区域？
options: With lint-free cloth that is moist with solvent
With cloth that is moist with water
optzh: 用蘸有溶剂的不起毛的布
questions.explain: lint-free cloth 不起毛的布；moist with solvent 用溶剂浸湿的

questions.q: Rewrite the sentence "Attach “DO NOT TOUCH flaps” to spoiler lever." by using a passive voice.
questions.qzh: 用被动语态改写句子 “Attach “DO NOT TOUCH flaps” to spoiler lever.”（把“请勿触碰”标牌挂到扰流板手柄上）。
options: “DO NOT TOUCH flaps” are attached to spoiler lever.
“DO NOT TOUCH flaps” attach to spoiler lever.
“DO NOT TOUCH flaps” are attaching to spoiler lever.
optzh: “请勿触碰”标牌被挂到扰流板手柄上。（被动语态）
“请勿触碰”标牌挂到扰流板手柄上。（主动形式，不是被动）
“请勿触碰”标牌正在挂到扰流板手柄上。（进行时，不是被动）
questions.explain: 被动语态 = be + 过去分词，原来的宾语变成主语

questions.q: ______ is used when our focus is on the object of the action.
questions.qzh: 当我们关注的是动作的对象时，使用______。
questions.explain: 关注动作的对象（而不是谁做的）时用被动语态

questions.q: Rewrite the sentence "Disconnect the electrical connectors." by using a passive voice.
questions.qzh: 用被动语态改写句子 “Disconnect the electrical connectors.”（断开电连接器）。
optzh: 电连接器被断开。（被动语态）
电连接器断开。（主动形式，不是被动）
电连接器正在断开。（进行时，不是被动）
questions.explain: 被动语态 = be + 过去分词；electrical connectors 电连接器

questions.q: ______ calls attention to methods and procedures that must be followed precisely to avoid injury to persons.
questions.qzh: ______提醒注意那些必须严格遵守的方法和程序，以避免人员受伤。
questions.explain: Warning（警告）防止人员受伤；Caution（警戒）防止设备损坏；Note 是补充说明

questions.q: CUT OFF THE SHARP POINT OF STUD FASTENERS IN AREAS WHERE PERSONS CAN TOUCH THEM. SHARP FASTENERS CAN CAUSE INJURIES. This warning suggests that ______.
questions.qzh: 在人员可能碰到的区域，切掉螺柱紧固件的尖端。尖锐的紧固件会造成人员受伤。这条警告建议______。
options: you should CUT OFF THE SHARP POINT OF STUD FASTENERS IN AREAS WHERE PERSONS CAN TOUCH THEM.
you should NOT TOUCH ANY STUD FASTENERS.
SHARP FASTENERS CAN CAUSE DAMAGE TO THE EQUIPMENT.
optzh: 你应该在人员可能碰到的区域切掉螺柱紧固件的尖端。
你不应该碰任何螺柱紧固件。
尖锐的紧固件会损坏设备。
questions.explain: stud fastener 螺柱紧固件

questions.q: The suggestion of the "CAUTION: DO NOT RUB THE PLASTIC SURFACES WITH A DRY CLOTH. THIS WILL CAUSE SCRATCHES AND AN ELECTROSTATIC CHARGE." is ______.
questions.qzh: “警戒：不要用干布擦塑料表面。这会造成刮痕和静电。”这条的建议是______。
options: DO NOT RUB THE PLASTIC SURFACES WITH A DRY CLOTH.
RUB THE PLASTIC SURFACES WITH A DRY CLOTH.
USE A DRY CLOTH TO REMOVE THE ELECTROSTATIC CHARGE.
optzh: 不要用干布擦塑料表面。
questions.explain: scratches and an electrostatic charge 刮痕和静电

questions.q: "CAUTION: MAKE SURE THE POLARITY IS CORRECT TO PREVENT DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT." means ______.
questions.qzh: “CAUTION（警戒）：确保极性正确，以防止设备损坏。”的意思是______。
options: 警戒：确保极性正确防止设备损坏。
警告：确保极性正确防止人员受伤。
警戒：极性错误不会损坏设备。
questions.explain: CAUTION = 警戒，针对设备损坏；WARNING = 警告，针对人员受伤。polarity 极性

questions.q: Find the action word in the instruction "Assemble the ring spring assembly."
questions.qzh: 找出指令 “Assemble the ring spring assembly.”（装配环形弹簧组件）中的动作词。
questions.explain: 句首 Assemble 是动词，句末 assembly 是名词；ring spring 环形弹簧

questions.q: The negative form of the sentence "Pull out the No. 1 Engine fire handle." is ______.
questions.qzh: 句子 “Pull out the No. 1 Engine fire handle.”（拉出1号发动机灭火手柄）的否定形式是______。
options: Don't pull out the No. 1 Engine fire handle.
Not pull out the No. 1 Engine fire handle.
Doesn't pull out the No. 1 Engine fire handle.
optzh: 不要拉出1号发动机灭火手柄。
questions.explain: 祈使句的否定 = Don't / Do not + 动词原形

questions.q: Install the screws to attach the valve to the skin. What's the usage of the screws?
questions.qzh: 安装螺钉，把活门固定到蒙皮上。螺钉的用途是什么？
questions.explain: to attach 表示目的：装螺钉是为了固定活门

questions.q: According to the instruction, "Stow a mask/regulator at each mask storage box." where shall we put the mask?
questions.qzh: 根据指令 “Stow a mask/regulator at each mask storage box.”（在每个面罩存放盒里存放一个面罩/调节器），我们应该把面罩放在哪里？
optzh: 在一个集中的存放盒里
questions.explain: stow 存放

questions.q: According to the instruction, "Decrease the pressure steadily." how to make the pressure low?
questions.qzh: 根据指令 “Decrease the pressure steadily.”（平稳地降低压力），怎样让压力降低？
questions.explain: steadily 平稳地、逐渐地

questions.q: If the component is not clean, discard it. According to the instruction, you should ______.
questions.qzh: 如果部件不干净，就把它丢弃。根据这条指令，你应该______。
options: throw it away when it is dirty.
throw it away when it is clean.
clean it and install it again.
optzh: 部件脏的时候把它扔掉。
部件干净的时候把它扔掉。
questions.explain: discard = throw away 丢弃

questions.q: Wash your hands before you service other systems. According to the instruction, you should ______ firstly.
questions.qzh: 在维护其他系统之前先洗手。根据这条指令，你首先应该______。
questions.explain: before 前面的动作先做：先洗手，再维护其他系统

questions.q: After the surface looks fully clean, remove the solvent with a mixed detergent. According to the instruction, ______ firstly.
questions.qzh: 表面看起来完全干净后，用调配好的清洁剂去除溶剂。根据这条指令，首先______。
options: make sure the surface looks fully clean
optzh: 确保表面看起来完全干净
questions.explain: After 后面的动作先发生

questions.q: Do the above steps again until the area is fully clean. According to the instruction, when shall we stop doing the above steps again?
questions.qzh: 重复上面的步骤，直到该区域完全干净。根据这条指令，什么时候停止重复上面的步骤？
options: When the area is fully clean
After we do the steps one more time
questions.explain: until 直到

questions.q: Do not put your head in the fuel tank access hole unless you have the correct respirator on. According to the instruction, ______ is correct.
questions.qzh: 除非戴上了正确的呼吸面罩，否则不要把头伸进油箱检修口。根据这条指令，______是正确的。
options: 你可以把头钻进油箱入口，即使你没有戴上了面罩。
你可以把头钻进油箱入口，没有戴上面罩也没关系。
如果你要把头钻进油箱入口，你必须正确地戴上了面罩。
questions.explain: unless 除非；respirator 呼吸器（面罩）

papers.note: Technical English of Aircraft Maintenance for General Mechanics Exercise - Day 1。正确答案按老师给的；第13、20题是老师的原选项，其余题的错误选项是整理时补的

papers.title: 第2天

questions.q: In ATA100, Towing and taxiing is in ______.
questions.qzh: 在 ATA100 中，牵引和滑行属于______。
optzh: ATA 第10章（停放、系留、封存和恢复使用）
questions.explain: towing 牵引；taxiing 滑行

questions.q: The reference of maintenance of aileron is contained in ______.
questions.qzh: 副翼维护的参考资料包含在______中。
questions.explain: aileron 副翼，属于飞行操纵系统（第27章）
73 是发动机燃油和控制；79 是滑油，74 是点火

questions.q: Choose an avionic system.
questions.qzh: 选出一个航电系统。
questions.explain: 通信（第23章）属于航电；起动（第80章）属于动力装置；飞行操纵（第27章）属于机体系统

questions.q: Choose a task of power plant group.
questions.qzh: 选出一项属于动力装置组的工作。
questions.explain: nose cowl 是发动机前端的进气整流罩，属于动力装置；flap track 襟翼滑轨属于飞行操纵/机翼；断电属于电源

questions.q: "B-HKE" is:
questions.qzh: “B-HKE”是：
questions.explain: A/C = aircraft 飞机；registration number 注册号
747 是机型，-400 是改型

questions.q: Zone 200 is:
questions.explain: 100 机身下部，200 机身上部，300 尾翼，400 动力装置/短舱，500 左机翼，600 右机翼，700 起落架及舱门，800 舱门

questions.q: "Refueling an aircraft" is classified as:
questions.qzh: “给飞机加油”归类为：
questions.explain: refuel 加油；servicing 勤务（第12章）

questions.q: "Cleaning landing gear control cables" is:
questions.qzh: “清洁起落架操纵钢索”是：
questions.explain: 清洁钢索是一项具体的维修工作（task）；trade 是工种，zone 是区域

questions.q: Service Bulletins are originated by:
questions.qzh: 服务通告（SB）由谁编发：
questions.explain: SB 由制造厂家发布；适航指令 AD 才由适航当局发布

questions.q: Removal/Installation information can be found in:
questions.qzh: 拆卸/安装信息可以在哪里找到：
questions.explain: AMM 页码块 401–499 是拆卸/安装

questions.q: The Page 208 in AMM is about:
questions.qzh: AMM 中的第 208 页是关于：
questions.explain: AMM 页码块：1–99 描述与工作原理，101 排故，201 维护实施，301 勤务，401 拆装，501 调整/测试，601 检查，701 清洁/喷漆，801 批准的修理

questions.q: "Effectivity: 004,006 with SB32-211" means:
questions.qzh: “Effectivity: 004,006 with SB32-211”（有效性：004、006，带 SB32-211）的意思是：
options: 适用于定制飞机中有效代码为004或006的飞机
适用于定制飞机中有效代码为004和006的飞机
适用于定制飞机中有效代码为004和006并有SB32-211的飞机
questions.explain: 004,006 是有效性代码；with SB32-211 表示还必须执行了 SB32-211

questions.q: Turn to Page ______ for the transmitter adjustment.
questions.qzh: 翻到第______页查看传感器（transmitter）的调整。
questions.explain: 501 to 599 Adjustment/Test 调校/测试

questions.q: The nod "." in front of the name of a part means the part is:
questions.qzh: 零件名称前面的点“.”表示这个零件是：
questions.explain: 卷子上 nod 应为 dot（点）。老师备注：部件名前加“.”表示该项目是上一级的组成部分

questions.q: If there is no spare of a part, you will:
questions.qzh: 如果某个零件没有备件，你会：
options: look for optional part number or interchangeable part number.
use any part with a similar name.
optzh: 查找可选件号或可互换件号。
随便用一个名字相近的零件。
questions.explain: spare 备件；optional part number 可选件号；interchangeable 可互换的

questions.q: In IPC index, 56-23-01-04-308, "04" stands for ______.
In the Nomenclature column of detailed parts list, you will find ______.
questions.qzh: 在详细零件清单的名称（Nomenclature）栏中，你会找到______。
questions.explain: 老师答案：名称栏里能找到供应商代码（vendor code）和可选件号；有效性和数量各有单独一栏

questions.q: In the AIPC part list, V92215 is ______.
questions.qzh: 在 AIPC 零件清单中，V92215 是______。
questions.explain: V 加五位数字是供应商（厂家）代码

questions.q: Chapter ______ is contained in SRM.
questions.qzh: SRM 中包含第______章。
questions.explain: 在 ATA100 里，51–57 章是飞机的结构部分，在结构修理手册（SRM）里

questions.q: "This repair does not apply to the areas that follow:" 这样的陈述说明______。
questions.qzh: “本修理不适用于下列区域：”这样的陈述说明______。
questions.explain: does not apply to 不适用于；applicability 适用范围

papers.note: Technical English of Aircraft Maintenance for General Mechanics Exercise - Day 2。正确答案按老师给的；第4、5、10、14、16、19题是老师的原选项，其余题的错误选项是整理时补的

papers.title: 第3天

questions.q: In aeronautical telecommunications, ______ stands for letter M.
questions.qzh: 在航空无线电通话中，______代表字母 M。
questions.explain: 航空通话字母表：M = Mike，N = November

questions.q: In aeronautical telecommunications, ______ stands for letter O.
questions.qzh: 在航空无线电通话中，______代表字母 O。
optzh: 欧米伽（希腊字母，不是通话字母）
questions.explain: 航空通话字母表：O = Oscar，P = Papa

questions.q: In aeronautical telecommunications, ______ stands for letter V.
questions.qzh: 在航空无线电通话中，______代表字母 V。
questions.explain: 航空通话字母表：V = Victor，W = Whiskey

questions.q: In aeronautical telecommunications, ______ stands for letter K.
questions.qzh: 在航空无线电通话中，______代表字母 K。
questions.explain: 航空通话字母表：K = Kilo，L = Lima

questions.q: When the aircraft is flying in the sky, the pilot says ______ to state the airplane registration number (B-HKJ).
questions.qzh: 飞机在空中飞行时，飞行员说______来报出飞机注册号（B-HKJ）。
questions.explain: B = Bravo，H = Hotel，K = Kilo，J = Juliet，“-” 读 dash

questions.q: BS stands for ______.
questions.explain: BS = Body Station 机身站位；BBL 机身纵剖线；BWL 机身水线

questions.q: CG means ______.
questions.qzh: CG 的意思是______。
questions.explain: CG = center of gravity 重心；中心线是 centerline，压力中心是 center of pressure

questions.q: The Body Buttock Line is a/an ______ plane parallel to the fuselage vertical centerline plane, BBL 0.00.
questions.qzh: 机身纵剖线（BBL）是一个平行于机身垂直中心平面（BBL 0.00）的______平面。
questions.explain: BBL 平行于机身垂直中心面，所以也是垂直面；水平面是 BWL（水线）

questions.q: ______ is a plane vertical to the BBL centerline plane and parallel to the fuselage centerline.
questions.qzh: ______是一个垂直于 BBL 中心平面、并平行于机身中心线的平面。
questions.explain: BWL 是水平面：垂直于 BBL 中心面，平行于机身中心线；BS 垂直于机身中心线

questions.q: The plane is measured from a point 92.50 inches forward of the nose. 这句话翻译为：______
questions.qzh: 这句话怎么翻译？
options: 此参照面从机头前方92.50英寸处开始测量。
此参照面从机头后方92.50英寸处开始测量。
此参照面从机头前方92.50厘米处开始测量。
questions.explain: forward of the nose 机头前方；inch 英寸

questions.q: Jack 意思是：______
questions.qzh: Jack 的意思是______。
questions.explain: jack 顶升（名词是千斤顶）；shoring 支撑；towing 牵引

questions.q: Which one is the primary jacking point?
questions.qzh: 哪一个是主顶升点？
questions.explain: primary jacking point 主顶升点；wing root 翼根，wing tip 翼尖

questions.q: The primary jacking points are used to ______.
questions.qzh: 主顶升点用来______。
questions.explain: 主顶升点用来顶起和放下飞机；让飞机稳定是辅助顶升点的作用

questions.q: The function of the auxiliary jacking points are to ______ after the airplane is jacked to the necessary height.
questions.qzh: 飞机顶升到所需高度后，辅助顶升点的作用是______。
questions.explain: auxiliary 辅助的；stable 稳定的

questions.q: If you use jacks that have the same general specifications but are not designed for the 767, you must be careful. 这句话翻译为：______
questions.qzh: 这句话怎么翻译？
options: 如果你使用通用规格相同、但不是专为767设计的千斤顶，你必须小心。
如果你使用通用规格相同、并且专为767设计的千斤顶，你必须小心。
如果你使用规格不同、但专为767设计的千斤顶，你必须小心。
questions.explain: general specifications 通用规格；not designed for 不是为……设计的

questions.q: Towbarless Tow Vehicle 意思是：______
questions.qzh: Towbarless Tow Vehicle 的意思是______。
questions.explain: towbar 拖把，-less 表示“没有”；tow vehicle 拖车

questions.q: Shear pin 意思是：______
questions.qzh: Shear pin 的意思是______。
questions.explain: shear pin 剪切销（安全销），载荷过大时被剪断起保护作用；开口销是 cotter pin

questions.q: The clearance must be between ______ and the adjacent airplane's ______.
questions.qzh: ______和相邻飞机的______之间必须有间隙。
optzh: 发动机排气口 … 机尾
questions.explain: APU exhaust port APU 排气口；adjacent 相邻的；wingtip 翼尖

questions.q: Make sure you have the necessary clearance when you go near a parked airplane or other structures. 这句话翻译为：______
questions.qzh: 这句话怎么翻译？
options: 当你走近一架停着的飞机或其他结构时，确保你们之间有必要的间隙。
当你走近一架停着的飞机或其他结构时，确保你得到了必要的许可。
当你离开一架停着的飞机或其他结构时，确保你们之间有必要的间隙。
questions.explain: clearance 在这里是“间隙、间距”，不是“许可”；go near 走近；parked 停放的

questions.q: MOST TOWBARLESS TOW VEHICLES DO NOT HAVE A SHEAR PIN TO LIMIT THE LOADS IF THE AIRPLANE BRAKES ARE USED DURING TOWING. 这句话翻译为：______
questions.qzh: 这句话怎么翻译？
options: 如果在拖行过程中使用飞机刹车，大部分无拖把拖车没有安全销来限制载荷。
大部分无拖把拖车都有安全销，在拖行过程中使用飞机刹车时可以限制载荷。
大部分无拖把拖车没有安全销，所以拖行过程中要使用飞机刹车来限制载荷。
questions.explain: do not have 没有；limit the loads 限制载荷；brakes 刹车

questions.q: Safety precaution 意思是：______
questions.qzh: Safety precaution 的意思是______。
questions.explain: precaution 预防措施；警告是 warning，检查是 inspection

papers.note: Technical English of Aircraft Maintenance for General Mechanics Exercise - Day 3。正确答案暂按参考答案（不是老师的），老师答案第5天发后核对；错误选项是整理时补的

papers.title: 第4天

questions.q: The air that is ______ by a ground cart is supplied to the airplane's main air distribution system through a conditioned air ground connector.
questions.qzh: 由地面空调车______的空气，通过空调地面接头供给飞机的主空气分配系统。
questions.explain: conditioned 调节过（温度）的，conditioned air 空调空气；ground cart 地面空调车；conditioned air ground connector 空调地面接头

questions.q: The conditioned air ground connector is an assembly which consists of ______ mounted to a duct assembly with an internal check valve.
questions.qzh: 空调地面接头是一个组件，由______组成，它安装在一个内部带单向活门的管道组件上。
questions.explain: adapter and seat assembly 接头和座组件；duct assembly 管道组件；check valve 单向活门

questions.q: Removal of the adapter and seat assembly does not require the removal of the duct assembly ______ the tee duct.
questions.qzh: 拆卸接头和座组件时，不需要把管道组件______三通管上拆下来。
questions.explain: removal of A from B：把 A 从 B 上拆下；tee duct 三通管

questions.q: Turn the L PACK selector, ______, P5, to the OFF position.
questions.qzh: 把______（P5）的左空调组件（L PACK）选择器转到 OFF 位。
options: on the pilot's center instrument panel
optzh: 在驾驶员中央仪表板上
questions.explain: P5 是驾驶员头顶板（overhead panel）；PACK 空调组件；selector 选择器

questions.q: Put a cover on the duct opening to keep ______ the unwanted material.
questions.qzh: 在管道开口上盖一个盖子，把不需要的东西挡在______。
questions.explain: keep out 挡在外面，不让进入；unwanted material 不需要的东西（外来物）

questions.q: Remove the screws and washers that ______ the check valve assembly to the duct.
questions.qzh: 拆下把单向活门组件______到管道上的螺钉和垫圈。
questions.explain: attach A to B：把 A 固定到 B 上；screw 螺钉；washer 垫圈

questions.q: Seats for the flight crew and observers are in ______.
questions.qzh: 飞行机组和观察员的座椅在______。
questions.explain: flight crew 飞行机组；observer 观察员；flight compartment 驾驶舱

questions.q: ______ are in the ceiling, and are used to store carry-on luggage, coats and garment bags.
questions.qzh: ______在天花板上，用来存放随身行李、外套和衣物袋。
questions.explain: overhead storage compartment 头顶行李箱（头顶储物舱）；closet 衣帽间不在天花板上；carry-on luggage 随身行李；garment bag 衣物袋

questions.q: Emergency, AMM25-60-00: procedures for ______.
questions.explain: AMM 25-60 应急设备：escape 逃生，life saving equipment 救生设备；防火是第26章

questions.q: ______ in the flight compartment provide means of escape through flight compartment windows.
questions.qzh: 驾驶舱里的______提供了从驾驶舱窗户逃生的手段。
questions.explain: escape rope 逃生绳，从驾驶舱窗户逃生用；escape slide 逃生滑梯装在舱门上

questions.q: The door-mounted escape slides are stored ______.
questions.qzh: 装在舱门上的逃生滑梯存放______。
questions.explain: door-mounted 装在舱门上的；escape slide 逃生滑梯；entry door 登机门，service door 勤务门

questions.q: Static dischargers discharge static buildup at ______.
questions.qzh: 静电放电刷在______释放积聚的静电。
options: the trailing edges of the airplane
the leading edges of the airplane
questions.explain: static discharger 静电放电刷，装在机翼和尾翼的后缘；trailing edge 后缘，leading edge 前缘；static buildup 静电积聚

questions.q: WARNING: USE EXTREME CARE WHEN YOU DRAIN THE IDG OIL. WEAR SPLASH GOGGLES, INSULATED GLOVES, AND PROTECTION GEAR. CONTACT WITH HOT OIL CAN CAUSE SERIOUS INJURY. According to the WARNING, you should wear ______ when you drain the IDG oil.
questions.qzh: 警告：放 IDG 滑油时要格外小心。穿戴 splash goggles、insulated gloves 和 protection gear。接触热滑油会造成严重伤害。根据警告，放 IDG 滑油时应该穿戴______。
options: 防溅型护目镜、绝缘手套和防护服
防溅型护目镜、棉手套和防护服
防溅型护目镜、绝缘手套和耳塞
questions.explain: splash goggles 防溅型护目镜；insulated gloves 绝缘手套；protection gear 防护服；IDG 整体驱动发电机

questions.q: Disconnect the oil-out line first at the check valve and then at the IDG. This requires loosening of the butterfly clamp that supports the oil line and nearby wire bundle. According to the instructions, which is wrong?
questions.qzh: 先在单向活门处、再在 IDG 处断开出油管。这需要松开支撑油管和附近导线束的蝶形卡箍。根据这段说明，哪一项是错的？
options: You should first disconnect the oil-out line at the IDG.
You should first disconnect the oil-out line at the check valve.
If you want to disconnect the oil-out line, you should loosen the butterfly clamp.
optzh: 应该先在 IDG 处断开出油管。
应该先在单向活门处断开出油管。
要断开出油管，应该松开蝶形卡箍。
questions.explain: 注意问的是哪一项错。顺序是先单向活门（check valve）、后 IDG，所以“先在 IDG 处断开”是错的；oil-out line 出油管；butterfly clamp 蝶形卡箍

questions.q: DO NOT SUPPLY MORE LIFT THAN NECESSARY TO HOLD THE IDG. EXCESSIVE LIFT OR FAILURE TO HOLD THE IDG PROPERLY CAN DAMAGE THE INPUT SEAL. According to the Caution, we should ______.
questions.qzh: 托住 IDG 时不要施加超过需要的托举力。托举力过大或没有正确托住 IDG 都会损坏输入端封严。根据这条注意事项，我们应该______。
options: supply only necessary lift to hold the IDG
supply a little greater than necessary lift to hold the IDG
supply a little less than necessary lift to hold the IDG
optzh: 只施加托住 IDG 所需要的托举力
施加比需要稍大一点的托举力来托住 IDG
施加比需要稍小一点的托举力来托住 IDG
questions.explain: more than necessary 超过需要的；excessive 过大的；input seal 输入端封严。力太大、托不住都不行

questions.q: DO NOT USE THE IDG INPUT SHAFT FOR LIFTING THE IDG. THIS WILL DAMAGE THE SHAFT. 这句话翻译为：______
questions.qzh: 这句话怎么翻译？
options: 不要使用IDG的输入轴来举起IDG。这样会损坏这个轴。
不要使用IDG的输出轴来举起IDG。这样会损坏这个轴。
要使用IDG的输入轴来举起IDG。否则会损坏这个轴。
questions.explain: input shaft 输入轴；lift 举起；DO NOT USE ... FOR ... 不要用……来……

papers.note: Technical English of Aircraft Maintenance for General Mechanics Exercise - Day 4。正确答案按老师给的；第2、8、12、13、14、15题是老师的原选项，其余题的错误选项是整理时补的

papers.title: 第5天

questions.q: The short form of "alternating current" is ______.
questions.qzh: "alternating current"（交流电）的缩写是______。
questions.explain: AC = alternating current 交流电；DC = direct current 直流电

questions.q: The full form of "ACM" is ______.
questions.qzh: "ACM" 的全称是______。
questions.explain: ACM = air cycle machine 空气循环机，空调组件里的制冷部件

questions.q: The short form of "波音客改货" is ______.
questions.qzh: “波音客改货”的缩写是______。
optzh: 波音民用飞机集团（Boeing Commercial Airplanes）
questions.explain: BCF = Boeing Converted Freighter 波音客改货；freighter 货机

questions.q: "LEFT SIDE FLT COMPT CEILING PANEL AND PASS COMPT CEILING" means ______.
questions.qzh: "LEFT SIDE FLT COMPT CEILING PANEL AND PASS COMPT CEILING" 的意思是______。
options: 左手边驾驶舱天花板面板和客舱天花板面板
左手边驾驶舱天花板面板和货舱天花板面板
左手边驾驶舱地板面板和客舱天花板面板
questions.explain: FLT COMPT = flight compartment 驾驶舱；PASS COMPT = passenger compartment 客舱；ceiling panel 天花板面板

questions.q: ______ does not mean “高出地板大约1-3英寸”.
questions.qzh: ______的意思不是“高出地板大约1-3英寸”。
optzh: Appr 不是 approximately 的缩写
questions.explain: 注意问的是“不是”。APPROX = approximately 大约；Appr 不是它的缩写（APPR 一般指 approach 进近）

questions.q: ______ is not the full form of "FOD".
questions.qzh: ______不是 "FOD" 的全称。
questions.explain: 注意问的是“不是”。FOD 有两个全称：foreign object damage 外来物损伤、foreign object debris 外来物碎片，除了这两个都不对

questions.q: ______ means "外部襟翼的前缘".
questions.qzh: ______的意思是“外部襟翼的前缘”。
questions.explain: LE = leading edge 前缘，TE = trailing edge 后缘；OUTBD = outboard 外侧，INBD = inboard 内侧

questions.q: “Turn the control wheel CW and then CCW”. According to the instruction, ______ is correct.
questions.qzh: “Turn the control wheel CW and then CCW”。根据这条指令，______是正确的。
options: 先顺时针再逆时针转动控制轮
先逆时针再顺时针转动控制轮
一直顺时针转动控制轮
questions.explain: CW = clockwise 顺时针；CCW = counterclockwise 逆时针；control wheel 控制轮（驾驶盘）

questions.q: SB is short for ______.
questions.qzh: SB 是______的缩写。
questions.explain: SB = service bulletin 服务通告

questions.q: The full form of "IRS" is ______.
questions.qzh: "IRS" 的全称是______。
optzh: 惯性导航系统（缩写是 INS）
questions.explain: IRS = inertial reference system 惯性基准系统；惯性导航系统是 INS

questions.q: When the engineers ask for TS support, they always raise a ______.
questions.qzh: 工程师请求技术支援（TS）时，通常会提交一份______。
questions.explain: TAR = Technical Assistance Request 技术援助申请；TS = technical services 技术支援；raise a form 提交表单

questions.q: ______ is the short form of "美国联邦民航局".
questions.qzh: ______是“美国联邦民航局”的缩写。
optzh: 美国联邦航空局（Federal Aviation Administration）
questions.explain: FAA = Federal Aviation Administration 美国联邦航空局

questions.q: The full form of "CDU" is ______.
questions.qzh: "CDU" 的全称是______。
questions.explain: CDU = control display unit 控制显示组件

questions.q: PTT switches are located at all flight interphone stations. PTT stands for ______.
questions.qzh: 所有飞行内话站位都有 PTT 电门。PTT 代表______。
questions.explain: PTT = push to talk 按下通话；flight interphone 飞行内话

questions.q: ______ is opposite to AFT.
questions.qzh: ______和 AFT 相反。
questions.explain: AFT 后；FWD = forward 前

questions.q: The short form of "总温" is ______.
questions.qzh: “总温”的缩写是______。
optzh: 外界大气温度（outside air temperature）
questions.explain: TAT = total air temperature 总温；SAT 静温

questions.q: The full form of "TE" is ______.
questions.qzh: "TE" 的全称是______。
questions.explain: TE = trailing edge 后缘；LE = leading edge 前缘

questions.q: The short form of "驾驶舱" is ______.
questions.qzh: “驾驶舱”的缩写是______。
questions.explain: FLT COMPT = flight compartment 驾驶舱

questions.q: ______ is the angle between the body's reference line and the oncoming flow.
questions.qzh: ______是机体基准线和迎面气流之间的夹角。
questions.explain: AOA = angle of attack 迎角；oncoming flow 迎面气流

questions.q: I/B Elevator (LH) means ______.
questions.qzh: I/B Elevator (LH) 的意思是______。
questions.explain: I/B = inboard 内侧，O/B = outboard 外侧；elevator 升降舵；LH = left hand 左，RH 右

papers.note: Technical English of Aircraft Maintenance for General Mechanics Exercise - Day 5。正确答案按老师给的；第5题是老师的原选项，第6题两个正确全称是老师给的、要选的第三个选项是整理时补的，其余题的错误选项是整理时补的
